title: A bare twin runs at its kb agent's effort, so research and mixed compare like with like
goal: bare_argv passes the kb agent's --effort to its twin (high for research and code agents, the default for lookups), and the dry run's bare argv lines show it

run:
import inspect, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_multi
assert '--effort' in ' '.join(bench_multi.bare_argv.__code__.co_consts.__repr__().split()) or 'effort' in inspect.getsource(bench_multi.bare_argv), 'a bare twin runs at the model default effort while its kb agent runs at high'
